sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.
Makes "Continue with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes banner, full-screen, app open and rewarded ads.
Removes the Alipay+ Rewards card and the cube icon in the header.
Removes the gift icon in the header and the invite section and row in the profile.
Unlocks Premium on the device: no ads, no upgrade banners and the Premium-only features that do not need the server.
